dct_title_s: Satellite  detected water extent over Aj Jabalain District, White Nile State of Sudan as of 19 September 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20210907SDN** This map illustrates satellite detected waters and the related potentially affected croplands as deduced using a Sentinel-2 satellite image acquired on 19 September 2021 over the Aj Jabalain District, White Nile State of Sudan. The water extent appears to have decreased of about 100 km2 since 14 September 2021. In this area, about 124 km2 of croplands appear to be likely affected by the flood waters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
